panels.title: Observed tactics (ATT&CK)
panels.description: Each event_type is mapped to its primary ATT&CK tactic. Same mapping logic as intel/mitre.py — replicated in SQL for live querying.

targets.queryText:
WITH b AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, CASE WHEN $__to - $__from < 21600000 THEN 0 ELSE ($__from / 1000 + 3599) / 3600 * 3600 END AS lo, CASE WHEN $__to - $__from < 21600000 THEN 0 ELSE $__to / 1000 / 3600 * 3600 END AS hi), w AS (SELECT severity, event_type, source_ip, COALESCE(honeypot_id, 0) AS honeypot_id, count AS n, bucket AS ts FROM alert_rollups, b WHERE lo < hi AND bucket >= datetime(lo, 'unixepoch') AND bucket < datetime(hi, 'unixepoch') UNION ALL SELECT severity, event_type, source_ip, COALESCE(honeypot_id, 0), 1, timestamp FROM alerts, b WHERE timestamp >= datetime(f, 'unixepoch') AND ((lo < hi AND timestamp < datetime(lo, 'unixepoch')) OR (lo >= hi AND timestamp <= datetime(t, 'unixepoch'))) UNION ALL SELECT severity, event_type, source_ip, COALESCE(honeypot_id, 0), 1, timestamp FROM alerts, b WHERE lo < hi AND timestamp >= datetime(hi, 'unixepoch') AND timestamp <= datetime(t, 'unixepoch'))
SELECT 'Reconnaissance (TA0043)' AS tactic, COALESCE(SUM(n), 0) AS count FROM w WHERE event_type IN ('dns_any_query', 'dns_query', 'dns_zone_transfer', 'http_active_recon', 'http_probe', 'http_recon_probe', 'ldap_invalid_probe', 'rdp_invalid_probe', 'rsync_invalid_probe', 'sip_extension_probe', 'sip_invalid_probe', 'sip_options_probe', 'sip_scan', 'snmp_invalid_probe')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Initial Access (TA0001)' AS tactic, COALESCE(SUM(n), 0) AS count FROM w WHERE (event_type IN ('http_exploit_attempt', 'http_login_success', 'imap_login_success', 'ldap_jndi_lookup', 'pop3_login_success', 'rdp_connection', 'rdp_handshake', 'rdp_mcs_handshake', 'rdp_nla_negotiate', 'rdp_nla_probe', 'redis_config_set', 'redis_key_set', 'smb_exploit_attempt', 'ssh_login_success', 'telnet_login_success') OR event_type GLOB 'honeytoken_triggered_*')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Execution (TA0002)' AS tactic, COALESCE(SUM(n), 0) AS count FROM w WHERE event_type IN ('docker_api_container_create', 'docker_api_container_start', 'docker_api_exec', 'docker_api_exec_start', 'docker_api_image_pull', 'kubernetes_pod_create', 'kubernetes_pod_exec', 'mysql_udf_rce', 'postgresql_copy_program_rce', 'postgresql_udf_rce', 'rdp_clipboard', 'rdp_command', 'redis_eval', 'redis_module_load', 'redis_rce_dropper', 'redis_rogue_replica', 'ssh_command_input', 'telnet_command_input')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Persistence (TA0003)' AS tactic, COALESCE(SUM(n), 0) AS count FROM w WHERE (event_type IN ('mysql_outfile_write') OR event_type GLOB 'honeytoken_triggered_ssh_key*')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Privilege Escalation (TA0004)' AS tactic, COALESCE(SUM(n), 0) AS count FROM w WHERE event_type IN ('docker_api_container_escape', 'kubernetes_pod_escape')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Credential Access (TA0006)' AS tactic, COALESCE(SUM(n), 0) AS count FROM w WHERE (event_type IN ('ftp_anonymous_login', 'ftp_login_attempt', 'http_credential_submit', 'imap_auth_attempt', 'imap_login_attempt', 'kubernetes_secret_access', 'ldap_bind_attempt', 'mssql_login_attempt', 'mysql_login_attempt', 'pop3_auth_attempt', 'pop3_login_attempt', 'postgresql_login_attempt', 'rdp_login_attempt', 'rdp_nla_auth', 'redis_auth_attempt', 'rsync_auth_attempt', 'sip_register_attempt', 'smb_ntlm_auth', 'smb_session_setup', 'smtp_auth_attempt', 'snmp_community_attempt', 'snmp_default_community', 'ssh_login_failed', 'ssh_login_success', 'telnet_login_failed', 'telnet_login_success', 'vnc_auth_attempt') OR event_type GLOB 'honeytoken_triggered_azure_credential*' OR event_type GLOB 'honeytoken_triggered_credential*')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Discovery (TA0007)' AS tactic, COALESCE(SUM(n), 0) AS count FROM w WHERE event_type IN ('dns_version_probe', 'docker_api_enumerate', 'docker_api_probe', 'docker_api_recon', 'elasticsearch_health_probe', 'kubernetes_enumerate', 'kubernetes_probe', 'kubernetes_rbac_enumerate', 'kubernetes_recon', 'ldap_anonymous_bind', 'ldap_search', 'memcached_version_probe', 'mysql_recon_query', 'nfs_export_enumeration', 'nfs_mount_probe', 'nfs_portmap_dump', 'nfs_portmap_probe', 'nfs_portmap_query', 'nfs_request', 'nfs_unknown_program', 'postgresql_recon_query', 'redis_config_get', 'redis_info_probe', 'rsync_module_access', 'rsync_module_enumeration', 'rsync_unknown_module', 'sip_extension_probe', 'sip_invite', 'sip_request', 'smb_negotiate')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Lateral Movement (TA0008)' AS tactic, COALESCE(SUM(n), 0) AS count FROM w WHERE event_type IN ('rdp_session', 'rdp_session_start', 'smb_exploit_attempt')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Collection (TA0009)' AS tactic, COALESCE(SUM(n), 0) AS count FROM w WHERE event_type IN ('elasticsearch_data_access', 'elasticsearch_health_probe', 'elasticsearch_query_probe', 'elasticsearch_recon_probe', 'imap_mailbox_access', 'imap_message_fetched', 'mysql_file_read', 'nfs_mount_attempt', 'nfs_portmap_dump', 'pop3_mailbox_access', 'pop3_message_retrieved', 'postgresql_file_access', 'rsync_anonymous_access', 'rsync_file_request', 'snmp_community_attempt', 'snmp_default_community')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Command and Control (TA0011)' AS tactic, COALESCE(SUM(n), 0) AS count FROM w WHERE (event_type IN ('dns_canary_callback', 'dns_tunneling_suspected', 'ftp_file_upload', 'ldap_jndi_lookup', 'smtp_open_relay', 'ssh_file_download', 'ssh_file_upload', 'ssh_port_forward', 'ssh_port_forward_data', 'ssh_port_forward_ja4h', 'telnet_file_download') OR event_type GLOB 'honeytoken_triggered_canary_url*')
  UNION ALL
SELECT 'Impact (TA0040)' AS tactic, COALESCE(SUM(n), 0) AS count FROM w WHERE event_type IN ('memcached_amplification_attempt', 'memcached_flush_all', 'memcached_large_set', 'memcached_stats_probe', 'mongodb_destructive', 'mongodb_ransom_note', 'sip_toll_fraud_attempt', 'snmp_bulk_request', 'snmp_set_request')
  ORDER BY count DESC

panels.title: Top event types (raw)
panels.description: Unmapped event types — useful for finding new attack patterns to extend the MITRE mapping with.

targets.queryText: WITH b AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, ($__from / 1000 + 3599) / 3600 * 3600 AS lo, $__to / 1000 / 3600 * 3600 AS hi), w AS (SELECT severity, event_type, source_ip, COALESCE(honeypot_id, 0) AS honeypot_id, count AS n, bucket AS ts FROM alert_rollups, b WHERE lo < hi AND bucket >= datetime(lo, 'unixepoch') AND bucket < datetime(hi, 'unixepoch') UNION ALL SELECT severity, event_type, source_ip, COALESCE(honeypot_id, 0), 1, timestamp FROM alerts, b WHERE timestamp >= datetime(f, 'unixepoch') AND ((lo < hi AND timestamp < datetime(lo, 'unixepoch')) OR (lo >= hi AND timestamp <= datetime(t, 'unixepoch'))) UNION ALL SELECT severity, event_type, source_ip, COALESCE(honeypot_id, 0), 1, timestamp FROM alerts, b WHERE lo < hi AND timestamp >= datetime(hi, 'unixepoch') AND timestamp <= datetime(t, 'unixepoch')) SELECT event_type, SUM(n) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT source_ip) AS unique_ips, SUM(CASE WHEN severity = 'critical' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS critical FROM w GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 20

WITH b AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, CASE WHEN $__to - $__from < 21600000 THEN 0 ELSE ($__from / 1000 + 3599) / 3600 * 3600 END AS lo, CASE WHEN $__to - $__from < 21600000 THEN 0 ELSE $__to / 1000 / 3600 * 3600 END AS hi), w AS (SELECT severity, event_type, source_ip, COALESCE(honeypot_id, 0) AS honeypot_id, count AS n, bucket AS ts FROM alert_rollups, b WHERE lo < hi AND bucket >= datetime(lo, 'unixepoch') AND bucket < datetime(hi, 'unixepoch') UNION ALL SELECT severity, event_type, source_ip, COALESCE(honeypot_id, 0), 1, timestamp FROM alerts, b WHERE timestamp >= datetime(f, 'unixepoch') AND ((lo < hi AND timestamp < datetime(lo, 'unixepoch')) OR (lo >= hi AND timestamp <= datetime(t, 'unixepoch'))) UNION ALL SELECT severity, event_type, source_ip, COALESCE(honeypot_id, 0), 1, timestamp FROM alerts, b WHERE lo < hi AND timestamp >= datetime(hi, 'unixepoch') AND timestamp <= datetime(t, 'unixepoch'))
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', datetime(CAST(strftime('%s', ts) / (CASE WHEN $__to - $__from < 21600000 THEN MAX(($__to - $__from) / 240000, 60) ELSE (MAX(($__to - $__from) / 240000, 3600) + 3599) / 3600 * 3600 END) AS INTEGER) * (CASE WHEN $__to - $__from < 21600000 THEN MAX(($__to - $__from) / 240000, 60) ELSE (MAX(($__to - $__from) / 240000, 3600) + 3599) / 3600 * 3600 END), 'unixepoch')) AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('dns_any_query', 'dns_query', 'dns_zone_transfer', 'http_active_recon', 'http_probe', 'http_recon_probe', 'ldap_invalid_probe', 'rdp_invalid_probe', 'rsync_invalid_probe', 'sip_extension_probe', 'sip_invalid_probe', 'sip_options_probe', 'sip_scan', 'snmp_invalid_probe') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Reconnaissance",
  SUM(CASE WHEN (event_type IN ('http_exploit_attempt', 'http_login_success', 'imap_login_success', 'ldap_jndi_lookup', 'pop3_login_success', 'rdp_connection', 'rdp_handshake', 'rdp_mcs_handshake', 'rdp_nla_negotiate', 'rdp_nla_probe', 'redis_config_set', 'redis_key_set', 'smb_exploit_attempt', 'ssh_login_success', 'telnet_login_success') OR event_type GLOB 'honeytoken_triggered_*') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Initial Access",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('docker_api_container_create', 'docker_api_container_start', 'docker_api_exec', 'docker_api_exec_start', 'docker_api_image_pull', 'kubernetes_pod_create', 'kubernetes_pod_exec', 'mysql_udf_rce', 'postgresql_copy_program_rce', 'postgresql_udf_rce', 'rdp_clipboard', 'rdp_command', 'redis_eval', 'redis_module_load', 'redis_rce_dropper', 'redis_rogue_replica', 'ssh_command_input', 'telnet_command_input') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Execution",
  SUM(CASE WHEN (event_type IN ('mysql_outfile_write') OR event_type GLOB 'honeytoken_triggered_ssh_key*') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Persistence",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('docker_api_container_escape', 'kubernetes_pod_escape') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Privilege Escalation",
  SUM(CASE WHEN (event_type IN ('ftp_anonymous_login', 'ftp_login_attempt', 'http_credential_submit', 'imap_auth_attempt', 'imap_login_attempt', 'kubernetes_secret_access', 'ldap_bind_attempt', 'mssql_login_attempt', 'mysql_login_attempt', 'pop3_auth_attempt', 'pop3_login_attempt', 'postgresql_login_attempt', 'rdp_login_attempt', 'rdp_nla_auth', 'redis_auth_attempt', 'rsync_auth_attempt', 'sip_register_attempt', 'smb_ntlm_auth', 'smb_session_setup', 'smtp_auth_attempt', 'snmp_community_attempt', 'snmp_default_community', 'ssh_login_failed', 'ssh_login_success', 'telnet_login_failed', 'telnet_login_success', 'vnc_auth_attempt') OR event_type GLOB 'honeytoken_triggered_azure_credential*' OR event_type GLOB 'honeytoken_triggered_credential*') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Credential Access",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('dns_version_probe', 'docker_api_enumerate', 'docker_api_probe', 'docker_api_recon', 'elasticsearch_health_probe', 'kubernetes_enumerate', 'kubernetes_probe', 'kubernetes_rbac_enumerate', 'kubernetes_recon', 'ldap_anonymous_bind', 'ldap_search', 'memcached_version_probe', 'mysql_recon_query', 'nfs_export_enumeration', 'nfs_mount_probe', 'nfs_portmap_dump', 'nfs_portmap_probe', 'nfs_portmap_query', 'nfs_request', 'nfs_unknown_program', 'postgresql_recon_query', 'redis_config_get', 'redis_info_probe', 'rsync_module_access', 'rsync_module_enumeration', 'rsync_unknown_module', 'sip_extension_probe', 'sip_invite', 'sip_request', 'smb_negotiate') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Discovery",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('rdp_session', 'rdp_session_start', 'smb_exploit_attempt') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Lateral Movement",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('elasticsearch_data_access', 'elasticsearch_health_probe', 'elasticsearch_query_probe', 'elasticsearch_recon_probe', 'imap_mailbox_access', 'imap_message_fetched', 'mysql_file_read', 'nfs_mount_attempt', 'nfs_portmap_dump', 'pop3_mailbox_access', 'pop3_message_retrieved', 'postgresql_file_access', 'rsync_anonymous_access', 'rsync_file_request', 'snmp_community_attempt', 'snmp_default_community') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Collection",
  SUM(CASE WHEN (event_type IN ('dns_canary_callback', 'dns_tunneling_suspected', 'ftp_file_upload', 'ldap_jndi_lookup', 'smtp_open_relay', 'ssh_file_download', 'ssh_file_upload', 'ssh_port_forward', 'ssh_port_forward_data', 'ssh_port_forward_ja4h', 'telnet_file_download') OR event_type GLOB 'honeytoken_triggered_canary_url*') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Command and Control",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('memcached_amplification_attempt', 'memcached_flush_all', 'memcached_large_set', 'memcached_stats_probe', 'mongodb_destructive', 'mongodb_ransom_note', 'sip_toll_fraud_attempt', 'snmp_bulk_request', 'snmp_set_request') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Impact"
FROM w GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%s', ts) / (CASE WHEN $__to - $__from < 21600000 THEN MAX(($__to - $__from) / 240000, 60) ELSE (MAX(($__to - $__from) / 240000, 3600) + 3599) / 3600 * 3600 END) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time

  SUM(CASE WHEN (event_type IN ('ftp_anonymous_login', 'ftp_login_attempt', 'http_credential_submit', 'imap_auth_attempt', 'imap_login_attempt', 'kubernetes_secret_access', 'ldap_bind_attempt', 'mssql_login_attempt', 'mysql_login_attempt', 'pop3_auth_attempt', 'pop3_login_attempt', 'postgresql_login_attempt', 'rdp_login_attempt', 'rdp_nla_auth', 'redis_auth_attempt', 'rsync_auth_attempt', 'sip_register_attempt', 'smb_ntlm_auth', 'smb_session_setup', 'smtp_auth_attempt', 'snmp_community_attempt', 'snmp_default_community', 'ssh_login_failed', 'ssh_login_success', 'telnet_login_failed', 'telnet_login_success', 'vnc_auth_attempt') OR event_type GLOB 'honeytoken_triggered_azure_credential*' OR event_type GLOB 'honeytoken_triggered_credential*') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Credential Access",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('dns_version_probe', 'docker_api_enumerate', 'docker_api_probe', 'docker_api_recon', 'elasticsearch_health_probe', 'kubernetes_enumerate', 'kubernetes_probe', 'kubernetes_rbac_enumerate', 'kubernetes_recon', 'ldap_anonymous_bind', 'ldap_search', 'memcached_version_probe', 'mysql_recon_query', 'nfs_export_enumeration', 'nfs_mount_probe', 'nfs_portmap_dump', 'nfs_portmap_probe', 'nfs_portmap_query', 'nfs_request', 'nfs_unknown_program', 'postgresql_recon_query', 'redis_config_get', 'redis_info_probe', 'rsync_module_access', 'rsync_module_enumeration', 'rsync_unknown_module', 'sip_extension_probe', 'sip_invite', 'sip_request', 'smb_negotiate') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Discovery",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('rdp_session', 'rdp_session_start', 'smb_exploit_attempt') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Lateral Movement",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('elasticsearch_data_access', 'elasticsearch_health_probe', 'elasticsearch_query_probe', 'elasticsearch_recon_probe', 'imap_mailbox_access', 'imap_message_fetched', 'mysql_file_read', 'nfs_mount_attempt', 'nfs_portmap_dump', 'pop3_mailbox_access', 'pop3_message_retrieved', 'postgresql_file_access', 'rsync_anonymous_access', 'rsync_file_request', 'snmp_community_attempt', 'snmp_default_community') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Collection",
  SUM(CASE WHEN (event_type IN ('dns_canary_callback', 'dns_tunneling_suspected', 'ftp_file_upload', 'ldap_jndi_lookup', 'smtp_open_relay', 'ssh_file_download', 'ssh_file_upload', 'ssh_port_forward', 'ssh_port_forward_data', 'ssh_port_forward_ja4h', 'telnet_file_download') OR event_type GLOB 'honeytoken_triggered_canary_url*') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Command and Control",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('memcached_amplification_attempt', 'memcached_flush_all', 'memcached_large_set', 'memcached_stats_probe', 'mongodb_destructive', 'mongodb_ransom_note', 'sip_toll_fraud_attempt', 'snmp_bulk_request', 'snmp_set_request') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS "Impact"
